title: Five Banners: Factions & Reputation
description: Faction tools for the Five Banners Burning campaign frame. Create factions and their relationships, hand them to the characters as they encounter them, and track each character's reputation with every faction on a new Factions tab. Also dresses every sheet and token ring in the Five Banners Burning style of the Daggerheart Core Rulebook module.

requires.reason: Provides the Five Banners Burning sheet theme, token ring, art and fonts this module builds on.

conflicts.reason: Five Banners can't run alongside this module and stays inactive while it is enabled.
